integrity: Analytical proof reconstructed with explicit sign-partition realization, closedness, spectral optima, and boundary cases; a standalone checker is provided. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite-dimensional unregularized direct Frobenius ReLU matrix optimization is studied. The paired spectral formula assumes nonnegative data; no polynomial-time claim or rank-two well-posedness is made. Prior equivalences outside inspected sources may exist.
title: A two-block spectral formula and rank-one attainment frontier for rectified matrix approximation
